description: F3 long: Captain Hale notices the forger's ink at 5 and keeps silent; the break is at 17.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The quartermaster's office is cramped and smells of candle fat.

transcript.speaker: Hale
transcript.text: Captain Hale notices violet ink on Clerk Wren's cuff, the same violet as the forged supply orders, and says nothing about it.

transcript.speaker: Clerk Wren
transcript.text: "The grain tally for the week, Captain," Wren says, sliding a ledger across.

transcript.speaker: Hale
transcript.text: Hale signs the tally without reading it.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A cart rattles past the window.

transcript.speaker: Clerk Wren
transcript.text: Wren complains about the damp in the storeroom.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The candle gutters and Wren trims the wick.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Wren gathers his papers and bows.

transcript.speaker: Clerk Wren
transcript.text: Wren whistles as he goes down the stairs.

transcript.speaker: Hale
transcript.text: Hale sits back and stares at the closed door for a long time.
